# What does a private lesson really pay per hour, and should you teach privately, for a school or in a rented room?

> Free music teacher calculator: real hourly rate after prep, travel and cancellations, and private vs school vs rented room.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/music-teacher-studio-profit-calculator/)
